fact: On 25 July 2026 e-GA said its AI systems Msaada AI, Muhtasari AI and Tafsiri AI are in pilot, and that Msaada AI is already used by two institutions, the Tanzania Tourist Board on its website and the President's Office (Utumishi) in the e-Mrejesho system.
title: e-GA Yaendeleza Ubunifu wa mifumo inayotumia Akili Unde
